title: Tide Engine
comment:
# Tide Engine

Orchestral film cue in D minor, about 40 bars at 96 BPM in 4/4 (about 100 seconds). It loops bar 40 back to bar 1, and the violas' C♯ at the end of bar 40 leads into the D on bar 1.

## Form

| Section | Bars | Chords | What happens |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Intro | 1–4 | Dm over a D pedal | Viola 3+3+2 ostinato and a contrabass D pedal, nothing else |
| A theme | 5–12 | Dm, B♭, Gm, A over the D pedal | Horn states the theme, an arch from D4 to G5; divisi pad enters, cellos double the ostinato from bar 9 |
| B mediants | 13–20 | D, F♯, D, B♭ | Flute and clarinet in octaves play the theme inverted; oboe joins at bar 17; horn glue chords, pizzicato |
| C build | 21–28 | B♭, B♭m, G♭, E♭m over a B♭ then E♭ pedal | Horns sequence the head motif; a layer enters every 2 bars up to snare roll and tuba |
| Climax | 29–36 | E♭m→D, then D, B♭, Gm, A | Tutti theme in D major; low brass play the head motif in augmentation; cymbal and bass drum |
| Outro / loop | 37–40 | Dm, B♭/D, A/D over the D pedal | Back to the intro layers plus a clarinet fragment of the head motif |

## Tracks

| Track | Part |
| --- | --- |
| Violins I | Climax theme with the flute |
| Violins II (16ths) | 16th ostinato, bars 25–36 |
| Violas (ostinato) | 3+3+2 ostinato throughout |
| Cellos | Ostinato an octave down, bars 9–36 |
| Contrabass | D, B♭, and E♭ pedals |
| Strings pad (divisi) | Sustained pad from bar 5 |
| Tremolo strings | High tremolo crescendo, bars 23–28 |
| Pizzicato | Color in the B section |
| Flute | Inverted theme, climax theme |
| Oboe | Unison with the flute, bars 17–20 |
| Clarinet | Inverted theme an octave down, outro fragment |
| Horns | Theme, glue chords, build sequence |
| Trumpets | Climax theme an octave below |
| Trombones | Build chords, augmented head motif |
| Tuba | Pedal from bar 27, octave under the trombones |
| Timpani | 3+3+2 cell and rolls |
| Percussion | Snare roll, cymbal, bass drum |

## Techniques

- The 3+3+2 eighth-note cell (accents on 8ths 1, 4, and 7) drives the ostinato, the timpani, the head motif D–A–B♭, and the augmented low-brass line.
- Chromatic mediants: D to F♯ and D to B♭ in the B section, D to B♭ again in the climax.
- The build runs a neo-Riemannian chain B♭–P–B♭m–L–G♭–R–E♭m–S–D, and the Slide lands on the climax at bar 29.
- The D pedal sits under Dm, B♭, Gm, and even A, which gives a crunchy dominant in bars 11–12.
- Panning follows orchestral seating, with violins left and low strings and brass right.
